title: America's deadliest fire that nobody remembers 🔥
subject: fire
description:
Had you ever heard of this fire? 👇

The Peshtigo Fire of October 8, 1871 is the deadliest wildfire in US history, yet it was overshadowed by the Great Chicago Fire on the very same night.

Sources: NOAA National Weather Service Green Bay ("The Peshtigo Fire"), Wisconsin Historical Society marker "Peshtigo Fire Cemetery" (HMdb), University of Wisconsin WI101 ("Two Fires"), Earth Magazine ("October 8, 1871: The deadliest wildfire in American history")

scenes.text: The flames moved so fast, survivors called it a tornado.
They said it threw rail cars into the air.
Many survived the night standing in a cold river.
Peshtigo, Wisconsin, October 8, 1871. Clearing fires and strong wind merged into one firestorm.
At least 1,200 died, the deadliest wildfire in US history. Over 350 were buried together, unnamed.
